policy.baseline: Exact current qualified noun comparator, original ordinary heads plus unchanged qualified add-ons. Full two-pass parity before any new selections. Actual native52 separately replayed with their frozen actual roles/ranges/masks.
policy.ordinary_gate: Inspect original structurally eligible shared links matching candidate actual mapped source POS. Any linked source_safe form retains candidate. Otherwise require source context token length > source focus token length AND original variant.distinct_components >=2. No actual-role eligible link abstains.
policy.conditional: Existing qualified noun conditional candidates are unchanged. No source-mask override.
policy.context: Original exact source_key/context/focus only; no token recomposition, target substitution, longest-match change, reranking, fit or new evidence. Wider context is minimum evidential support, not semantic certification.
policy.threshold: 2 independent retained alignment components, frozen once; no search. This differs from qualified noun rule head-specific support and does NOT claim independent sense-specific support.
policy.known: Existing two frozen 25% states, original family-order control; never actual-user knowledge.
policy.masks: Every original enclosing-unit and protected-range mask survives gate removal.
policy.safe_flag: Historical native single-sense/lexical/nonlemma and grammatical/name suitability metadata; not complete source meaning truth. Wrong-POS safe forms cannot rescue actual-POS unsafe forms.

review: All52 already exposed diagnostics; no new blind/population accuracy claim. Preserve earlier labels; additive current assessment calibrates just/Solo as uncertain intent, capitalization separate. Retain all changed source/target candidate IDs and actual full outputs.
